correctness.rationale: For each non-induced H embedding, conditioning on the presence of its e prescribed edges forces exactly d_v edges at each internal vertex v; thus its degree distribution becomes d_v+Bin(n−1−d_v,p), whereas external vertices retain Bin(n−1,p). Consequently Cov(D_k,X_H)=((n)_h/a_H)p^e P_{n,k}(p)[Σ_v(k)_{d_v}/((n−1)_{d_v}p^{d_v})−h] for n≥h≥2 and 0<p<1, with H having no isolates. Each nonzero term in the bracket decreases strictly with p. For k<δ it is −h; δ≤k≤n−2 gives a unique root, increasing strictly with k by falling-factorial monotonicity; k=0 negative and k=n−1 positive. Expanding (n−1)_{d}=n^d[1−d(d+1)/(2n)+O(n⁻²)] and applying the simple-root implicit expansion gives exactly the displayed c/n plus second-order term for fixed H,k. The n^{e−h} normalized limit follows from Poisson binomial convergence; no uniformity in growing H,k. All steps follow conditional identities rather than finite enumeration alone.
